_doc: Real-robot stage 2: the left turn and docking, no box. Same arena, markers and dock as arena_lab.json (extends). Put the robot on (1.5, 1.25) facing -x (towards the left end panel): it drives 1 m to the corner, turns left and docks. python main.py --real --task config/stage2_corner.json. Stage 3 = arena_lab.json without the box, stage 4 = with the box at (2.75, 1.25).
